list_api.scope: Separate post-run HTTP call using unchanged MemoryClient, including full typed response validation; not instrumented runner preflight

preparation.scope: Unmodified server Docker timestamped access-log response-header emission boundaries, not full body transfer / typed validation completion. Includes HTTP preflight listing and driver overhead. Extraction and indexing overlap insertion; no independent stage timings.

comparison_proxy.scope: Total runner run() duration minus all 210 recall sample durations: includes registration, both setup stages, both preflight listings, Python/JSON/HTTP overhead. Not a direct 1000-item preparation measurement.
